# Solutions Architect — Sydney (Contract, 6-12 months)

We're looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to join a major
digital transformation program at a NSW Government department.

**You will:**
- Lead end-to-end solution design across ServiceNow, Salesforce, and Mulesoft.
- Engage senior stakeholders up to C-level on architecture decisions.
- Coach delivery teams on patterns and best-practice.
- Work closely with Enterprise Architecture and Cyber for review board sign-off.

**You bring:**
- 10+ years architecting enterprise solutions in regulated environments
  (government, banking, insurance).
- Deep experience with at least one of: ServiceNow ESM, Salesforce, Microsoft 365.
- Strong communication and consulting skills.
- Comfort with Agile, Lean, ITIL.
- Australian work rights.

**The role:**
- Day rate: $1300-$1500 inc super
- Hybrid Sydney (2-3 days/week onsite)
- ASAP start
